source: face.wa (swapped-block ZIP) -> ~zl1g.dat=Unit_mov, ~gtl.dll=Unit_atk, ~kvr.db=Unit_spc (Ls12 archives, 270 entries each, same entry index in all three)
palette: shared sprite range (indices 10..173 identical in every palette); index 0 = transparent

mov.layout: vertical strip, frame i at y = i*frame_h

atk.layout: vertical strip, frame i at y = i*frame_h

spc.layout: vertical strip, frame i at y = i*frame_h

mirroring.rule: right-facing frames are NOT stored: the engine mirrors the left-facing frames horizontally (row mirror 0x41edf7 via 0x41ee53)

direction_codes.note: unit byte +0x0f (0x43e320); attack loader 0x403b8f jump table 0x403d75

anchor.note: 48x48 frames cover the cell; 64x64 attack frames are drawn centred on the cell (offset -8,-8) - CCZ convention, not re-verified in the blitter

entry_index.rule: g = graphic_id(person); if g < 43: entry = g*3 + min(unit.side, 2) else entry = g + 86
entry_index.unit.side: unit byte +5 (0..2) selects colour variant: entry g*3+0 red, +1 green, +2 blue (colours as seen; which army is which side value: see data docs)
graphic_id(person): person record = [0x4d0048] + pid*0x48 (pid = word +0 & 0xfff); class = byte +0x2b
override v = person_override[pid] (person.wa loaded to 0x55a000 by 0x4d00fc); tier = class % 3
v=0: no override -> CLASS_TO_GRAPHIC[class] if class < 0x35 else 0x45
